statement: If a tensor U degenerates to LL ℓ=1⟨aℓ, bℓ, cℓ⟩, with all dimensions positive integers, then L ∑ ℓ=1 (aℓbℓcℓ)ω/3 ≤ R(U). In particular, if T⊗n ⊗ A ⊵ LL ℓ=1⟨a, b, c⟩ and R(A) ≤ R, then L(abc)ω/3 ≤ 3n R. (3.3)
